master_preservation: Original upstream save_wav output retained unchanged; no post-generation EQ, normalization, denoising, trimming, compression or re-encoding. SilentCipher embedding was enabled and executed. The watermark integration internally resamples during encoding as designed by upstream.
quality_limits: Approved first-contact and identity: whole-clip ASR matched both lines. This does not prove absence of extra sounds or establish subjective voice quality; user audition supplied acceptance.
Approved first-contact: 850ms tail-only ASR produced ambiguous さあ; 450ms tail produced no words. Short-crop recognition is not reliable proof of an extra utterance.

Ten new dialogue masters: mechanical and visual waveform checks only. No native audio perception was available; naturalness, vocal character, absence of nonlexical sounds and in-game mix require listening evaluation.

New dialogue full ASR supports the intended readings, with recorded orthographic/decoding ambiguity for restore-power (してる/している), next-terminal (よし/よーす) and return-packets (文/分, both ぶん). Do not describe all transcripts as exact matches.

Tail-only ASR sometimes produces unrelated text on short fragments or silence. These outputs were reviewed with full recognition and waveform boundaries, rather than treated as proof of spoken extra words.
The 12.52-second synthetic conditioning reference is shorter than the publisher’s approximately 30-second recommendation for optimal speaker similarity.

SilentCipher embedding ran for all masters. The reference and all 10 final new dialogue masters recovered the full expected payload. Neither of the 2 approved short A80 masters did; their bytes and original verification status remain unchanged.
In-game listening, playback mix and iOS Safari remain unverified for this expanded set.
